describe: Which prediction-market topics the daily briefing watches, and the research-map concept each points to. Selection is by tag and liquidity, fixed here, never by hand on the day. A briefing is context for a reader. No rule or gate reads it.
terms_note: Read-only public market data, no key. Polymarket's terms restrict access from listed jurisdictions and restrict redistribution of its data, so raw downloads and briefings stay out of this repository; only this file is tracked.
